name: infraerp
observations: Construction-operations ERP — one shared operational environment: Commercial, Contracts, Technical, Accounting, Warehouse, Logistics, Brigadier, Management.
Canon: ENTER INFORMATION ONCE, SYNCHRONIZE EVERYWHERE — one row written, filtered into every view; never copy facts between tables/pages.
Lives at C:\lab\infraerp\infraerp; data dir via SYNCHRO_DATA env, default ../synchro-data (synchro.db + files/ + backups/).

name: infraerp-stack
observations: Node.js ES modules, Express-style router in server/app.js (h() wraps handlers → JSON; HttpError/bad() → 4xx).
SQLite via node:sqlite DatabaseSync — synchronous, no ORM. server/db.js is the single schema file + additive ALTER migrations. tx(db,fn)=transaction; nextCode(db,'MRQ')=running-number gen.
React+TypeScript+Vite in web/ — shared kit web/src/ui.tsx (useLoad, useAction, useForm, useCan, Modal, Table, Field).
design.md is the domain spec (Bulgarian). CHECKLIST.md tracks phases. CHANGELOG.md gets an entry every shipped change, same session.

name: infraerp-commands
observations: Run: node server/index.js → http://127.0.0.1:4800 (PORT env).
Full tests: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs (~40s, ~60 tests). Web build: cd web && npm run build.
Mint session: insert row into sessions(token,user_id,expires_at); cookie name synchro_sid.
Probe-mounted-not-written: POST invalid body → 400 = route mounted; 404 = missing.

name: infraerp-conventions
observations: Permissions: need(user,'module','read'|'write') throws 401/403; can() returns bool; canSeeProject(db,user,pid) scopes per-project. Every route gates server-side.
Modules: commercial, contracts, technical, progress, warehouse, logistics, brigade, accounting, management, admin.
Events: emit(db,user,{type,origin,project_id,entity_type,entity_id,dedupe_key,next,affected}) → server/domain.js handlers.
Audit: audit(db,user,{...}) — corrections are auditable, never destructive edits. Money/stock math lives ONLY in server/calc.js.
Paired facts are one write: project↔project transfer writes transfer_out + transfer_in inside tx(); never accept the second half as user-supplied kind.
Bulgarian UI/errors. Tests: test/helpers.mjs start(), seedOffer(t), mkUser, sync().

name: infraerp-pipeline
observations: After ANY change (.devin/skills/review-pipeline contract): root cause first (systematic-debugging), failing test first.
node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs all green; cd web && npm run build clean.
Live-verify routes mounted (400-vs-404 probes); NO writes on real DB — write-path proof = tests or :4801 clone.
Review bots: product-engineer review vs design.md, audit pass, QA outcome vectors.
CHANGELOG.md entry, git status/diff sweep, kill every temp process. Only :4800 stays running.
